added.summary: margin, margin-left/-right, margin-inline (and -start/-end) and margin-block-start/-end take px, em, rem, viewport units, percentages (of the parent's content width, as CSS 2 §8.3 has it), negatives, auto and calc(). In a block's flow auto left and right margins centre or push the box (margin: 0 auto); in a flex line auto margins take the free space and align the item across it; in a grid area they align the item and other margins inset it.

added.member: UI documents: mixed-unit calc(), min(), max(), clamp()
added.summary: A length calc() reduces to a linear sum of %, px and em terms, with rem and vw/vh/vmin/vmax turned into px when the element resolves; layout resolves the percentage against the basis it already has. min(), max() and clamp() over such sums are evaluated at layout. width: calc(100% - 12px) and min(100%, 600px) work, a var() term bound with style:--name moves only its element, and a viewport unit re-resolves on resize.
